Summary: Defines the Phase 1 assignment and result contract for the Delivery Architect component-spec materialization proof workflow.

# Delivery Architect Component Spec Materialization Assignment Result Contract

## Purpose

Define the first explicit assignment/result contract for the Delivery Architect workflow that:
- refactors a governed component authority doc into a materialization-ready bridge artifact
- runs the doc-to-model materialization proof flow
- returns a structured result packet to `TechLead`

This contract is narrower than a general `delivery_review_packet`.
It is a workflow-specific specialization for the `Component Spec -> model materialization proof` lane.

## Contract Position In The PAA Methodology

This contract sits between:
- `Component Design` authority
- `Delivery Architect` bridge work
- downstream `ImplementationPlan` and component-model truth

The contract does **not** replace the governed component authority doc.
It transports the scoped work assignment and the structured result of proving that the component authority doc can drive executable model truth.

## Packet Family Decision

Phase 1 should use:
- `techlead_assignment_packet`
- `delivery_review_packet`

It should **not** introduce a brand-new schema family yet.

Reason:
- the TechLead routing contract already defines:
  - `TechLead -> Delivery Architect` via `techlead_assignment_packet`
  - `Delivery Architect -> TechLead` via `delivery_review_packet`
- this workflow needs a constrained payload profile, not a new routing family

So the Phase 1 operation is:
- one specialized `techlead_assignment_packet` profile for component-spec materialization proof
- one specialized `delivery_review_packet` profile for proof results

## Phase 1 Assignment Contract

## Top-Level Envelope

The assignment must keep the standard hub envelope:
- `message_id`
- `schema_type = techlead_assignment_packet`
- `schema_version`
- `project`
- `from_role = techlead`
- `to_role = delivery-architect`
- `created_at`
- `correlation_id`
- `github_context`
- `payload`
- `authority_context`

## Assignment Type

For this workflow the assignment payload must include:
- `assignment_type = component_spec_materialization_proof`

This value is the switch that tells Delivery Architect which automation/skill path to execute.

## Required Assignment Payload Sections

| Section | Required | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `issue` | yes | GitHub and work-item continuity |
| `branch` | yes | canonical and role-branch lineage |
| `target_component` | yes | names the component under proof |
| `target_authority_doc` | yes | absolute path to the governed component authority doc |
| `authority_docs` | yes | governing template, mapping, and extraction-rule docs |
| `expected_materializer` | yes | names the runner or script expected to reconcile the model |
| `expected_proof_commands` | yes | exact commands Delivery Architect must run |
| `deliverable_requirements` | yes | required outputs to return |
| `source_assignment_context` | yes | why TechLead sent this assignment now |
| `previous_proof_context` | no | prior run references if this is a rerun |

## Required Assignment Payload Shapes

### `target_component`

Must include:
- `component_name`
- `component_kind`
- `alignment_state`
- `target_repo = paa-platform`

### `target_authority_doc`

Must include:
- `path`
- `doc_id`
- `doc_type`
- `authority_source` if applicable

### `authority_docs`

Must include references to:
- component-spec template authority
- section-to-model mapping authority
- extraction rules authority
- materialization policy authority

### `expected_materializer`

Must include:
- `script_path`
- `mode`
- `reconciliation_scope`

Initial allowed `mode` values:
- `doc_driven_materialize_from_spec`
- `doc_driven_materialize_from_contract`

### `expected_proof_commands`

Must include command entries for:
- governed doc lint
- model/code consistency
- spec/model consistency
- any slice-specific materializer command

### `deliverable_requirements`

Must require:
- updated governed authority doc if conformance work is needed
- validation summary
- blocking findings list
- next-step recommendation

      "doc_id": "workflow-lifecycle-service-component-spec",
      "doc_type": "component-spec"
    },
    "expected_materializer": {
      "script_path": "/Users/billyweisberg/Repos/billyweisberg/paa-platform/scripts/runtime/materialize_workflow_lifecycle_from_component_spec.py",

## Phase 1 Result Contract

## Top-Level Envelope

The result must keep the specialized spoke-result envelope:
- `message_id`
- `schema_type = delivery_review_packet`
- `schema_version`
- `project`
- `from_role = delivery-architect`
- `to_role = techlead`
- `created_at`
- `correlation_id`
- `github_context`
- `payload`
- `authority_context`

## Review Type

For this workflow the result payload must include:
- `review_type = component_spec_materialization_proof`

## Required Result Payload Sections

| Section | Required | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `issue` | yes | issue continuity |
| `branch` | yes | branch/worktree continuity |
| `pr` | no | PR context if a doc/code branch was opened |
| `result_type` | yes | constrained Delivery Architect outcome |
| `proof_target` | yes | identifies the component and target doc under proof |
| `conformance_summary` | yes | whether template-conformance work was required and completed |
| `materialization_summary` | yes | whether the doc-driven reconcile path ran and what it touched |
| `proof_results` | yes | exact proof command outcomes |
| `findings` | yes | blocking and non-blocking findings |
| `techlead_action_recommended` | yes | the next legal TechLead move |
| `source_assignment_ref` | yes | reference to the triggering assignment |
| `artifacts` | yes | updated docs, scripts, validation notes, or evidence paths |

## Allowed `result_type` Values

Initial constrained values:
- `proof_pass_ready_for_dev`
- `proof_pass_ready_for_follow_on_materialization`
- `needs_authority_clarification`
- `needs_scope_narrowing`
- `needs_materialization_fix`
- `cannot_prove_with_current_authority`

## Result-Type Semantics

| Result type | Meaning | Typical TechLead next move |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `proof_pass_ready_for_dev` | authority doc is materialization-ready and proof checks passed for a dev-facing slice | `assign_worker` |
| `proof_pass_ready_for_follow_on_materialization` | proof passed, but the next correct move is another Delivery Architect or producer-side bridge slice | `assign_delivery_architect` or `escalate_to_authority_architect` |
| `needs_authority_clarification` | governing authority is too ambiguous to fail safely into materialization | `escalate_to_authority_architect` |
| `needs_scope_narrowing` | the target doc is too broad or conflates multiple component slices | `assign_delivery_architect` |
| `needs_materialization_fix` | proof target is sound but runner or reconcile surface is still incomplete | `assign_delivery_architect` or `pause_slice` |
| `cannot_prove_with_current_authority` | current authority doc cannot support this proof lane without structural redesign | `escalate_to_authority_architect` |

## Required `proof_results` Shape

The result must include explicit outcomes for:
- `governed_doc_lint`
- `model_code_consistency`
- `spec_model_consistency`
- `materializer_run`

Each proof result entry should include:
- `status`
- `command`
- `blocking_gaps`
- `notes`
- `evidence_refs`

## Required `conformance_summary` Shape

Must include:
- `was_template_conformant_at_start`
- `conformance_changes_applied`
- `required_sections_added`
- `remaining_structural_gaps`

## Required `materialization_summary` Shape

Must include:
- `materializer_path`
- `reconciliation_scope`
- `model_entities_touched`
- `component_ids`
- `implementation_plan_ids`
- `activity_keys_reconciled`

## Required `techlead_action_recommended` Values

Initial constrained values:
- `assign_worker`
- `assign_delivery_architect`
- `escalate_to_authority_architect`
- `pause_slice`

## Result Example Shape

```json
{
  "schema_type": "delivery_review_packet",
  "from_role": "delivery-architect",
  "to_role": "techlead",
  "payload": {
    "review_type": "component_spec_materialization_proof",
    "result_type": "proof_pass_ready_for_dev",
    "proof_target": {
      "component_name": "WorkflowLifecycleService",
      "authority_doc_path": "/Users/billyweisberg/Repos/billyweisberg/paa-platform/docs/2_Design/2026-05-17-workflow-lifecycle-service-component-spec.md"
    },
    "proof_results": {
      "governed_doc_lint": {"status": "pass"},
      "materializer_run": {"status": "pass"},
      "model_code_consistency": {"status": "pass", "blocking_gaps": []},
      "spec_model_consistency": {"status": "pass", "blocking_gaps": []}
    },
    "techlead_action_recommended": "assign_worker"
  }
}
```

## Fail-Closed Rules

Delivery Architect must return a non-pass result if any of the following are true:
- required structured sections are missing from the authority doc
- extractor fails to parse the governed tables
- expected materializer cannot run
- model/code proof has blocking gaps
- spec/model proof has blocking gaps
- the proof lane depends on unstated authority or hand-written DB reconciliation

TechLead must not treat the result as dev-ready if:
- `result_type` is anything other than `proof_pass_ready_for_dev`
- `techlead_action_recommended` is not `assign_worker`
- any proof result entry still reports blocking gaps

## Delivery Architect Exit Criteria

A Phase 1 run is complete only when:
- the target authority doc is template-conformant or an explicit blocker is recorded
- the doc-driven materializer path is named and executed
- proof results are returned in structured form
- TechLead can decide the next move from the packet alone without rereading the whole thread

## Not True Yet

This contract does **not** yet define:
- queue persistence schema changes
- a standalone `delivery_architect_assignment_packet`
- a standalone `component_spec_proof_result_packet`
- the automation runner implementation

Those belong to later phases.
Phase 1 only defines the assignment/result contract shape needed to wire the existing capability into the Delivery Architect lane.
